evaluation.feedback: The song is a very catchy, high-energy trap instrumental. I really enjoyed the syncopated percussion and the crispness of the hi-hats. The melodic synth lead is simple but effective, creating a driving, confident mood that works well for a background track or a workout playlist. It feels professionally produced, though it stays quite consistent throughout without a major shift in intensity.
evaluation.suggested_prompt: An upbeat, high-energy trap instrumental with a syncopated 808 beat, crisp hi-hat rolls, and a bright, melodic synthesizer lead in F# major. Add a contrasting breakdown section with atmospheric textures before returning to the main beat.
